title: Conditional Incrementer
statement: Build an 8-bit conditional incrementer that adds 1 to the operand when enable is high, and otherwise passes the operand unchanged. The output must be stable combinationally and must not use storage elements. This supports increment-by-one operations in datapath circuits.
module_signature: module conditional_incrementer(input [7:0] a, input enable, output [7:0] y);
behavior: Purely combinational: outputs must settle after input changes.
Do not depend on initial register values, clocks, or delays.
All outputs must be driven to known 0/1 values for every input case.
hint: Use addition only when enable is asserted.
